svg.title: M8f layout: one page map for codes and scales
svg.desc: For toy page size four and block table five comma two, logical token five maps to physical page two, offset one. Its INT8 key codes and FP32 key scale share that address and reconstruct one head vector. The value has separate codes and scale. At head dimension 128 the pair occupies 132 bytes instead of 256 BF16 bytes.

g.text: M8f: the codes and scales travel together
Same logical history, same page ownership; a different representation inside each physical slot.
Toy page size = 4 · block table = [5, 2] · logical token = 5
logical page = 5 // 4 = 1 → physical page = table[1] = 2 · offset = 5 % 4 = 1
4 bytes · the value vector has its own scale
132 stored bytes vs 256 BF16 bytes per head-vector
Append token 6 → page 2, offset 2. Write its codes and scales; leave tokens 0–5 unchanged.
Quantize post-RoPE K once. Reusing its cache entry must not rotate or re-quantize it again.
Storage arithmetic, not a speedup claim. Real pages use 16 tokens; this example uses 4.
